metadata.title: Project LUMI
metadata.description: The LUMI platform for living, interactive children's stories.

footer.tagline: Worlds that remember, grow, and live through stories.

login.sceneKicker: Your story is waiting for you
login.sceneText: The traces of your last story, the people you met, and the places you explored are still here. When you sign in, LUMI takes you forward from your own history instead of starting over.
login.cardDescription: Sign in with your parent account so your profiles and living universes can continue where they left off.

errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password did not match.
errors.invalidInput: Please check your email and password again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts were made. Please try again shortly.
errors.failed: Sign-in could not be completed right now. Please try again.

success.signedOut: You signed out. You can sign in again.
success.passwordReset: Your password was reset. Sign in with your new password.

parentHome.intro: Here, every child has their own world, memories, and continuing stories. Choose a profile to continue where you left off, or take the first step toward a new world.
parentHome.readyStateText: LUMI only shows child and world states that are actually recorded; it never presents something as if it happened when it did not.
parentHome.setupStateText: Once the universe and child profile are ready, this area will become the starting point for living stories.
parentHome.profileCount: {count, plural, =0 {No child profiles yet} one {# child profile ready} other {# child profiles ready}}
parentHome.childrenTitle: A separate world for every child
parentHome.emptyText: A profile is the safe starting point for age range, interests, and developmental preferences that will personalize stories later.
parentHome.profileCardText: You can prepare this profile's character and then move into their living story universe.
parentHome.worldNewsTitle: Small notes from real world state
parentHome.worldNewsReady: There is no verified world-event feed yet. LUMI therefore does not invent news here; once the real world-state feed is ready, only canonical developments will appear in this area.
parentHome.worldNewsSetup: After the first child profile and universe are created, verified world developments will appear here later as a calm summary.
parentHome.nextStepReady: Each child's character, interests, and story history are kept separate. Choose a profile to enter their own world.
parentHome.nextStepSetup: Once universe and profile setup are complete, you can move on to character and story preparation.
